titulo.estudio: Un courriel personnel : Observer les formes

intro: Follow the purpose of an email and tell apart the request, the explanation and the suggested reply. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Follow the purpose of an email and tell apart the request, the explanation and the suggested reply. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: the polite conditional softens a request; connectors explain why another date is suggested. In this passage, «disponibilité» means «availability».

frases.estudio: Je voudrais réserver la salle avant jeudi, car le tarif augmente ensuite.
frases.alumno: I'd like to book the room before Thursday, because the price goes up after that.

frases.estudio: Si tu ne peux pas venir samedi, on pourrait organiser la rencontre dimanche matin.
frases.alumno: If you can't come on Saturday, we could arrange the meeting for Sunday morning.

frases.estudio: Bonjour Claire, pourrais-tu me confirmer ta disponibilité pour le week-end du 12 ?
frases.alumno: Hi Claire, could you confirm whether you are available the weekend of the 12th?
